why_agent_cannot: the drop requires a Telegram or Discord account session
what_human_must_do: Go to app.allscale.io or get the iOS or Android app from allscale.io. Register with your email and the 6-digit code it sends. The docs say: "Registration takes two quick steps: verify your email, then set up a passkey". The passkey is optional; you can set it up later and sign in with email only.
Verify your email (100 AS Points) and sign in once on the mobile app (800 AS Points).
Open Rewards in the app. The Overview, Referral and Redeem Code tabs show your points, your invite link and the code field.
Earn the repeatable points: log in on 7 days in a row, and use the app for real invoices and Claim Links. Points from payments scale with the USDT you receive.
Follow AllScale on X, Telegram and Discord for campaigns with redeem codes, and enter any code you get under Redeem Code. Where redeem codes go in the app. Source: AllScale docs

Check any account that contacts you at app.allscale.io/official-verification. Warning The wallet lets you export your secret phrase. Never paste it anywhere. AllScale says: "We never ask for your private key or seed phrase."
costs: Registering and the one-off tasks cost nothing, and no deposit is needed to sign up. Most repeatable points, though, come from money you actually receive, so they suit people who already get paid in stablecoins.
